query:
SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_ROWS 
FROM information_schema.TABLES 
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() 
AND TABLE_NAME IN ('userHabits','habitCompletions','journalEntries','userProgress','userAchievements','userSideQuests')
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
